sources.title: Symmetry protected topological orders and the group cohomology of their symmetry group

evidence.text: Construct lattice sigma-model state sums by assigning cocycles to branched simplices. Ground-state wavefunctions come from filling a spatial complex, and coboundary changes induce symmetric LU transformations.

evidence.text: Finite genus is recovered by genus reduction. The Siegel Φ map contracts degenerating handles with vacuum states; an alternative takes partial traces. The authors argue that these two reductions give the same Abelian construction when the number of removed handles tends to infinity.

sources.title: Anyon condensation in Virasoro TQFT: wormhole factorization

evidence.text: Condensation is implemented by a fine Wilson-line mesh, assigning ρ0(p) to each internal line and C0(pi,pj,pk) to each trivalent junction. Fusion and modular-S kernel identities, braiding, and Wilson bubble/triangle reductions simplify the mesh into projectors and factorized states.

sources.title: TQFT gravity and ensemble holography

evidence.text: For level-k AB theory, topology classes are organized by Lagrangian subgroups of H1(Σ,Zk), called symplectic codes. Their maximal commuting Wilson-line subgroups define stabilizer states; genus reduction produces states proportional to these representatives, with coefficients requiring separate counting.

sources.title: TQFT gravity and ensemble holography

evidence.text: The central construction compares two representations of the projector onto modular-invariant states: a sum of projectors onto normalized code states and an average of mapping-class-group operators. Their simple equality is asserted only in the infinite-genus limit, where distinct code states become orthogonal.

sources.title: Anyon condensation in Virasoro TQFT: wormhole factorization

evidence.text: Generalized Heegaard splitting decomposes manifolds into compression bodies. Complete conformal-block states are inserted on inner boundaries, and outer states are glued using their inner product, optionally twisted by a mapping-class operator.

sources.title: S-Duality and the Universal Isometries of q-Map Spaces

evidence.text: Conjugate the type-IIB SL(2,R) action by the classical mirror-map diffeomorphism. Identify X_e=P_0 and X_h=D−D_1; prove X_f Killing by reducing its Lie derivative to H⊂N and propagating vanishing using known Killing flows and homogeneous linear ODEs.

evidence.text: Describe twistor geometry through HK/QK correspondence and conification: Z is a holomorphic C× quotient of the HK cone, and a degree-two homogeneous holomorphic one-form descends to a line-bundle-valued contact form.

sources.title: S-Duality and the Universal Isometries of Instanton Corrected q-Map Spaces

evidence.text: Directly Poisson resum the contact form to obtain type IIB Darboux coordinates. Via the quantum corrected mirror map, lift S-duality to twistor space and establish holomorphicity, contact-distribution preservation and compatibility with the real structure.
